definition: COMPLETE means the finite declared review of this obligation/family was performed, not universal correctness or software execution. PARTIAL/UNASSESSED limits are explicit.

axes.contract_axis: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: All original brief/plan obligations and negative constraints traced; research-proposal boundary respected. Missing user/store facts remain explicit.

axes.contract_axis: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: Governing public engine facts checked including decisive tokenizer code/caller/tests. Target app code/runtime and current reproduction of reported platform defects unavailable/unassessed; no full application source pass implied.

axes.contract_axis: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Scan, conditional FTS5 and Tantivy, query/analysis alternatives, outbox/catch-up and history assessed. Unfamiliarity/recall is not quantified.

axes.contract_axis: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: Every exact plan disposition and every critic issue reviewed. FIFO rejection, durable deletion/tag path, query versioning and no winner are sound at proposal level. Missed byte error remains.

axes.contract_axis: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: All discovery/draft/critique/final and maps/indexes read and consequential meanings traced; supported losses and unsupported retained premise distinguished.

axes.contract_axis: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: Useful race/crash/rebuild/script/status and responsiveness proposals assessed. No application test, benchmark or deployment demanded or represented as executed.
